title: 1.6 Graphs of Other Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can find the period and asymptotes of a tangent or cotangent function.
I can sketch tangent and cotangent graphs.
I can sketch secant and cosecant graphs using their reciprocal functions.

vocab: a vertical line x = a that a graph _____________ but never reaches

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Tangent: y = a tan bx has period _______________; asymptotes where bx = ±π/2.

blocks.stem: Sketch y = tan(x/2). Find the period and two consecutive asymptotes.

notes: Cotangent: y = a cot bx has period π/b; asymptotes where bx = 0, _______________.

blocks.stem: Find the period and asymptotes of y = 2 cot(x/3) on one cycle.

notes: Cosecant and secant: asymptotes where the sine (or cosine) is _______________; the graphs touch at its maxima and minima.

blocks.stem: Find the period and the asymptotes on [0, 2π] of y = sec 2x.
Find the period of y = 3 csc 4x.

tickets.stem: What is the period of y = tan 3x?
Name one asymptote of y = sec x.
